pages.description: What limited information Arithim Ltd collects through this website, and how we handle it.

p: Arithim Ltd is an applied AI company based in London, United Kingdom. It builds software products and works with clients on AI projects. This policy explains what limited information we collect through this website and how we handle it.

Arithim Ltd is a private limited company registered in England and Wales, company number 17209022. Our registered office is 6 Dorchester Court, Greenlands Road, Staines-Upon-Thames, England, TW18 4LS. We are the controller of the personal information described here. You can reach us at hello@arithim.com.

We only collect the information you choose to send us: the details you enter in the contact form, and any messages you send to hello@arithim.com or research@arithim.com. The site itself uses no advertising trackers. The contact and demo request forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to block automated submissions and Resend to deliver your message to our inbox.

When you visit, Cloudflare, which hosts this site, processes technical data such as your IP address and request details so that it can deliver and protect the site. Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address and browser details when a page opens.

If you use the switch between the dark and light themes, the site remembers your choice in your browser's local storage on your device. It stays on your device and is not sent to us. We set no cookies for analytics or advertising. Services on our forms and the Call us button, such as Cloudflare Turnstile, may store small items in your browser to work.

We use your details only to respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, to discuss a potential engagement or research collaboration. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

If you ask about a report or a product, register interest in an early access product, or order a report by email, we use what you send to reply, to supply the report and to keep a record of the order. We keep order records for as long as the law requires for accounting and tax.

sections.h: Calls and chats with our AI assistants
p: The Call us button on this site lets you speak or type to Arithim's AI assistants. They are AI, not people, and you are told so before the call starts. The service is for people aged 18 or over, and for business enquiries. Please do not use it to share sensitive personal information such as health details. The assistants do not make any decision about you that has a legal or similarly significant effect. They answer questions, take messages and pass them to a person, who replies within one working day.

sections.h: What we collect from calls and chats
p: Your voice is processed live so that it can be turned into text. We ask the voice provider not to keep the audio. We keep the transcript of the conversation, the details you choose to give (such as your name, organisation, email address or phone number, and what you want to talk about), a short summary, and technical data such as your IP address, which we store only as a salted hash and use to prevent abuse and limit repeated use.

We use this information to answer your enquiry, to pass your message to Tarun, to keep the service secure and within its usage limits, and to improve how the assistants answer. Our lawful basis is legitimate interests in answering enquiries and running the service safely. Where you ask us to take steps towards an engagement, we also use it to do so at your request.

ElevenLabs processes your voice and runs the voice conversation. Anthropic provides the AI model that writes the assistants' replies. Cloudflare hosts this site and stores the call records. Resend sends the internal notification email to us. Each acts as a processor on our instructions, under its data processing terms. We do not sell this information and do not use it for marketing.

These providers process data in the United States. Where data leaves the UK, we rely on the UK International Data Transfer Addendum, or on the UK extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, as set out in each provider's data processing terms.

ElevenLabs keeps conversation data for no more than 30 days and does not store the audio. Our own records of calls and chats are deleted after 90 days. We keep a message for longer only where it becomes an ongoing enquiry or engagement, and then under the same terms as the rest of our correspondence with you.

You can ask us at any time to access, correct, or delete the information you have shared with us. This includes anything you told our AI assistants. You can also object to our use of your information, ask us to restrict it, or complain to the Information Commissioner's Office. To make a request, email hello@arithim.com, quoting the reference the assistant gave you if you have one, and we will respond promptly.
We update this policy when what we do changes. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
Questions about this policy can be sent to hello@arithim.com.
